note: Which voices round 2 puts forward. Their clips are stored in ../clips; every other voice was generated, checked and measured the same way and is described in samples.json by its numbers only (Kokoro can remake any of them in under a second).
kept_as_evidence_note: chatterbox-default-7 is the Japanese sentence exactly as written, where Chatterbox's own front end reads 今日は as the greeting. It is not on a board; chatterbox-kana-7 is.

why.kokoro-am_santa: Older candidate: the oldest-sounding stock voice by the age guess (67) and one of the slowest. Weakest training data of any English voice (grade D-).
why.kokoro-bm_george: Older candidate: second-oldest stock voice by the age guess (57), the slowest stock voice (159 words a minute), and the best grade among the older-sounding men (C).
why.kokoro-bm_lewis: Older candidate by the brief's rule: second-lowest pitch (90 Hz) and slow (170 words a minute). Age guess 47. Grade D+.
why.kokoro-am_onyx: Older candidate by the brief's rule: the lowest pitch of all (86 Hz). Not slow (193) and not old by the age guess (39). Grade D.
why.kokoro-old_gs: Blend, 60% George and 40% Santa, at 0.92 speed: the oldest-sounding blend by the age guess (63), mostly built on the better-graded voice.
why.kokoro-old_so: Blend, 60% Santa and 40% Onyx, at 0.92 speed: nearly as old by the age guess (61) and much deeper than Santa alone (124 Hz against 167).
why.qwen-elder_m: Made from the description 'an elderly man in his seventies with a warm, deep, unhurried voice': the slowest (145 words a minute) and nearly the deepest (94 Hz) of everything here. Age guess 59.
why.qwen-elder_m2: Made from the description 'a British man of about eighty with an aged, gravelly, kind voice': age guess 64, second only to Santa. A little less steady from line to line than the other described voice.
why.chatterbox-slower: The voice the designer liked (Chatterbox A) with the calmest settings that still behaved: 9% slower than round 1's, no older.
why.kokoro-af_bella: A woman unlike Heart in age guess (43 against 31) though not in pitch; the best-graded voice after Heart (A-).
why.kokoro-af_kore: A woman unlike Heart: 50 Hz lower (151 against 202). Grade C+.
why.kokoro-bf_isabella: A woman unlike Heart: British. Grade C.
why.kokoro-am_fenrir: For range: the best-graded man not heard in round 1 (C+), and a young one by the age guess (24).
